The family owns live sandbox identity, brokers, quarantine, and teardown observations. Lifecycle changes are admitted Agentgres operations and the family mints no independent sequence, receipt, root, or transition chain.

contract_definition_of_done: Each new family lands with a schema and invariants file, positive and negative fixtures, and a conformance owner that proves the named refusals.
Every cross-reference is declared authoritative or derived; no ambiguous bidirectional admission, sandbox, broker, quarantine, promotion, or teardown edge is accepted.
A registry entry alone is presence, not closure, and cannot satisfy this work item.
